_comment: GATE-HYGIENE-2402: backend test files the change-based gate selection ALWAYS runs (scripts/gate/select_tests.py, read from the checkout under test).
A file belongs here when one of its tests walks the whole backend package (rglob over smplwise/, services/ or routers/), the router registry
(_routers(), pkgutil over smplwise.routers, app.routes) or the repository (git ls-files). No import closure or name stem reaches such a test
from a far change, so a mapping-only selection skips it - main v2.39.0 shipped red on the SR-1 pin that way.
tests/test_gate_always_run.py fails when a file matches the detector (select_tests.PACKAGE_SCAN_RE) and is neither listed in 'backend' nor
reviewed in 'not_scanners'. Add the file in the same commit as the scanner; the value is the scanner test and what it pins.
